constraint_results.judge_reason: The implementation clamps the effective timeout to 0 (max(0, timeout_ms - clock_skew_ms)) rather than the required minimum of 1 ms (max(timeout_ms - clock_skew_ms, 1)). Additionally, there is no call to orgops.tracing.annotate_span() to annotate the trace span with 'lock.acquired' on successful lock acquisition. Both requirements of the constraint are missing.
